question: Do causal Binance futures positioning states identify H01 entries where immediate execution is fragile and a minimal micro-limit helps?

source.checksum: validate every archive against its adjacent .CHECKSUM file
source.coverageNeeded: eight UTC days ending on every eligible H01 signal date

population.eligibleSignals: H01 S12/S13/S14 signals on or after 2020-09-01 with complete prior seven-day metrics

causality.history: only metrics timestamps at or before lastAllowedMetric

features.priceChange1h: BTC 5m close at t-5m divided by close at t-65m minus one
features.oiChange1h: sum_open_interest at t-5m divided by t-65m minus one
features.takerRatio1h: geometric mean of sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio over the last 12 closed snapshots
features.rollingRank: strict percentile rank against the previous seven days ending t-10m

states.CROWDED_LONG: oiChange1h > 0 and accountLongShort rollingRank >= 0.75 and topPositionLongShort rollingRank >= 0.75

executionComparison.flaggedAction: M70_O025_T15 only on flagged signals; A otherwise
executionComparison.entryInvariant: retain every eligible signal and total target weight 1
executionComparison.costsAndExit: same Run3 production oracle, funding, fee/slippage and four scenarios as frozen earlier

diagnosticGate: state has at least 8 flagged signals in both discovery and OOS
adaptive policy net delta versus A is positive in discovery and OOS
drop-top-20% delta is positive in discovery and OOS
drawdown is no worse than A in discovery and OOS
2024 and 2025 net deltas are each non-negative
stress and alternative intrabar OOS net deltas are positive
interpretation: Exploratory because aggregate micro-ladder OOS was inspected before this conditional hypothesis. A pass may justify a new untouched forward test, but cannot authorize live deployment by itself.
safety: Research only; no server edit, arming, deploy, order, or position action.
